puzzles.name: Slide under the overhang
puzzles.notes: Land the T flat on the stack, slide it left under the overhang, then rotate clockwise. The TST kick drops it two rows into the slot.

puzzles.name: Build the overhang
puzzles.notes: Drop the O on the left to make the roof, then slide the T under it and rotate clockwise.

puzzles.name: Iso TST
puzzles.notes: Rotate counterclockwise, move right twice and soft drop. Then rotate clockwise, 180 (it kicks one cell left), and clockwise again into the TST. Needs SRS+ 180 kicks.
